text:
incident-bot: P1 alert triggered for Regent Corp (enterprise · VPC) — elevated 5xx and request queuing in eu-west-1 dedicated pool. PagerDuty page to leo-oncall.
leo-oncall: on it, jumping in. can someone confirm customer impact?
jess-cs: Regent reporting increased error rates in their dashboard, some requests timing out ~30s. they flagged us at 06:12 UTC.
maria-sre: looking at infra now — tails from dedicated pool show high CPU on pool-gpu-eu3 and connection errors to datastore svc.
samir-eng: I see many gRPC CANCELLED and backend 503s on the tenant shard. likely backend scaling didn't kick in.
leo-oncall: key priorities: isolate tenant if noisy, shift traffic to warm capacity in eu-west-2, and coordinate DNS TTL change for Regent's vanity endpoint if needed.
olivia-se: Regent wants minimal disruption; prefer transparent failover (LB-level) before vanity DNS cutover. have they allowed us to update their CNAME/TTL?
jess-cs: they signed off on emergency DNS changes if required; prefer we try pool failover first.
maria-sre: running live checks — kernel OOMs on one worker host in pool-gpu-eu3-azb. initiating node drain for that host.
chris-net: creating immediate route to warm pool in eu-west-2. will advertise via internal routing and update load balancer weights.
leo-oncall: maria, samir — plan for tenant isolation? If we isolate Regent to warm pool we need to ensure KV cache priming and model KV compatibility.
samir-eng: agreed. recommend warm pool with same model family and quantization profile. we can spin warm workers and pre-populate prefix cache using recent request logs.
maria-sre: kicking off warm pool spin with autoscaling override to desired 12 workers in eu-west-2.
deploy-bot: deploy started: warm-pool:regent:v2 — image sha: d1f4c9a — initiated by maria-sre.
leo-oncall: chris, what's the LB command to move 60% of traffic to warm pool?
chris-net: running weight update now. command:```shell
# update weights
curl -X POST https://infra-api.local/lb/update-weight \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $LB_TOKEN" \\
  -d '{"service":"regent-enterprise","routes":[{"pool":"eu-west-2-warm","weight":60},{"pool":"eu-west-1-primary","weight":40}] }'
```
chris-net: submitted — status: pending, will confirm when backend health checks green.
maria-sre: warm workers are initializing. starting KV cache priming — replaying 10k recent prefixes. progress 40%.
leo-oncall: monitoring dashboards — adding temporary strip chart for 5xx by pool.
olivia-se: I've told Regent this is the plan and asked them to stand by for TTL change if cutover needed.
jess-cs: Regent on the phone with me now — they prefer DNS flip if performance doesn't stabilize within 10 minutes.
samir-eng: we should prepare Route53 change-set in advance. sample change-batch below, TTL 30s:```json
{
  "Changes": [
    {"Action": "UPSERT", "ResourceRecordSet": {"Name": "ai.regent.com.", "Type": "CNAME", "TTL": 30, "ResourceRecords": [{"Value": "lb-eu-west-2.redwood-inference.net."}]}}
  ]
}
```
maria-sre: warm pool health checks are passing for model svc but we have elevated tokenization latency on one worker — investigating.
chris-net: LB weight update accepted. real traffic shift now: eu-west-2 warm pool at 60%. watch for 5xx delta.
leo-oncall: watching SLO dashboard. initial 5xx rate dropped from 7% to 3% in the last 30s. good sign.
jess-cs: Regent reports perceived latency reduced for some requests, still seeing occasional 502s.
maria-sre: digging into model infra logs — a rate limiter on worker side was tripping due to auth token retries. bumped rate limiter threshold for Regent's tenant id.
samir-eng: cache priming done, model KV hit rate 78% now on warm pool. should improve tail latency.
leo-oncall: set Canary monitors: if 5xx < 1% for 5m, continue to shift more traffic. if not, prep DNS cutover.
incident-bot: Note: On-call handoff scheduled in 50 minutes to sara-sre.
chris-net: pushing another weight change to 80/20 eu-west-2/eu-west-1 to reduce load on faulty host.```
chris-net: update applied. current traffic now 80% eu-west-2.
maria-sre: 5xx stabilized at 0.8% over last 3m. tail latency 95p reduced to 220ms.
jess-cs: Regent acknowledges improvement. they're okay to hold on DNS change. thanks team. :thumbsup:
leo-oncall: summary for postmortem: root cause suspected OOM on host combined with auth retry storms from Regent's integration; mitigation: isolate tenant to warm pool, bump rate limiter, cache priming, LB weights shift. action items: automated node drain on OOM, tighten auth retry backoff guidance in docs, add tenant-level rate limiting alerts.
olivia-se: Regent wants a scheduled warm-handoff drill with us next month to test failovers. I'll coordinate.
maria-sre: beginning de-escalation — will keep warm pool at reduced weight (20%) for 30m for safety, leaving this thread open.
leo-oncall: handing off to sara-sre for overnight watch. sara, ping me if anything flares.
deploy-bot: deploy completed: warm-pool:regent:v2 — 12 workers healthy.
sara-sre: acknowledged handoff, will monitor.
leo-oncall: thanks all, great work — please add a short incident note to the tracker and tag with customer:regent and impact:regional-failover.
jess-cs: adding customer timeline and call notes to the incident tracker now.
